narration.text: Standoff annotations can overlap. But their intersections are more than a visual phenomenon.
Every annotation occupies a range of text. Its relationship to another range can therefore be calculated.
Or they may meet without sharing a single character.
When annotations are represented as database records, these relationships can become query predicates.
Now consider a question for an annotated corpus. Which places are mentioned in passages of direct speech that also mention Napoleon?
Begin with the entity itself, and follow its mentions through the corpus.
The wording need not be identical.
Find the speech annotations containing those mentions.
In the Brussels passage, Napoleon is outside the quotation.
Then find the place mentions contained within those same passages.

caption: Graph traversal. Textual geometry. Graph traversal.

narration.text: Follow the matching mentions back to the graph, and the answer emerges: Paris and Vienna.
Independent annotation ontologies can participate in the same inquiry. Their creators need not have anticipated the questions that will later be asked.

caption: The geometry of annotations becomes a language of inquiry.

narration.text: The geometry of annotations becomes a language of inquiry.
